scope: Bounded primary-source check and practical research assessment during registered v4 training. Not an exhaustive novelty review, venue assessment, or proof of learned competence.

sources.title: FORGE: Force-Guided Exploration for Robust Contact-Rich Manipulation under Uncertainty
sources.verified_scope: Force-aware learned manipulation, dynamics randomization, success prediction and multiple assembly tasks with real-robot experiments.

sources.title: ARCH: Hierarchical Hybrid Learning for Long-Horizon Contact-Rich Robotic Assembly
sources.verified_scope: Hybrid learned and planned primitives, demonstrations, simulation and real manipulation; insertion and grasp recovery examples.

sources.title: FORGE-plus: Force-Budgeted Recovery for Contact-Rich Assembly with a Frozen LLM Supervisor
sources.verified_scope: Frozen text supervisor selects a fixed recovery menu in simulation; reports recovery outcomes and unsuccessful PPO under strict force constraints. Different task and scope; its rates are not comparisons with this project.

sources.title: Reverse Curriculum Generation for Reinforcement Learning
sources.verified_scope: Performance-adaptive start-state curricula for simulated goal-directed manipulation.

inferences_and_decision_criteria: Assembly, recovery, force-aware learning and adaptive curricula already have substantial prior art. The proposed difficulty score alone is not a defensible novelty claim.
The practical contribution must be an empirically supported answer about complete-job reliability per charged training cost, with witnessed recovery separated from prevention.
First establish a competent learned baseline under the frozen job criteria. Debugging rewards and critic fitting is enabling engineering, not the final research contribution.

After competence, compare uniform, adaptive and fixed curriculum with shared architecture, reward, nominal allocation, support, seeds and budget; retain the upstream reference and fixed retry baseline.

A substantial research claim requires multiple training seeds, a second contact task, held-out combinations, physics sensitivity checks and a failure-mechanism ablation. Simulation-only evidence limits deployment claims.
Do not replace missing comparative evidence with an LLM supervisor, a new robot, a polished website or a larger network.
conditional_postbudget_diagnosis: If the fixed competence gate fails, first classify all 84 primary requests by nominal/fault outcome, force abort, witnessed failure, withdrawal and completed recovery. Do not change the gate.

Compare full discounted returns and job completion on existing matched development controls. Removing individual stall counterexamples does not mathematically guarantee alignment of expected reward with completion probability: early risky success may still outreturn slower reliable recovery. Treat this as a hypothesis until measured.

Use actor action targets, motion and force traces to separate extraction errors, inadequate recovery behavior and remaining reward conflicts. Additional stochastic/critic rollouts require a specific unresolved question and an explicit small budget.

Stop repeated reward or optimizer tuning if the evidence does not isolate a blocker; finish the defensible benchmark and report the baseline limitation rather than start an adaptive campaign without competence.

future_capacity_permission.user_authorized: 2048 or 4096 environments may be used in future if previous work is preserved. No change to the executing registered 1024-environment run.
future_capacity_permission.limitations: Short earlier development probes; larger batches are unmeasured. They do not establish long-run throughput, RAM capacity or policy learning speed at 2048/4096.
future_capacity_permission.practical_next_test: After the current learning milestone, benchmark 2048 first in a new bounded development run with the same physics and representative workload; consider 4096 only if measured RAM, GPU headroom and throughput justify it. Include startup, optimizer and export overhead; measure active samples per second as well as total slots per second.
future_capacity_permission.acceptance: Adopt a larger batch only after artifact validity and sustained wall-time improvement. Preserve all older runs, charge probes, and preregister the same new configuration for every future comparison arm.
future_capacity_permission.optimization_caution: Doubling environments changes samples per PPO batch and, at fixed cohort-based budget, the number of policy updates and sampler feedback rounds. It is not automatically a pure speed optimization. High absorbing fractions are not cured by more environments; do not change terminal/reset semantics merely to fill the GPU.
future_capacity_permission.token_efficiency: Use the existing bounded launcher with persistent redirected logs and inspect meaningful saved checkpoints; no sleep-guard work or additional housekeeping framework.
